newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV to exclude 28 firms from public trade.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV to exclude 28 firms from public trade.

text.p: Spain's stock market commission CNMV opened procedures to exclude from public trading 28 listed firms which are not meeting minimum levels of frequency and volume in trading, nor information requirements, CNMV said on Monday.
All these stocks are traded on the open-outcry market.
Following are the stocks which are to be studied:

Arregui (in liquidation), Aurium, Banco de Promocion de Negocios, Baqueira Beret, Cementos Alfa, Cointra, Colon de Inversiones, Comercial de Laminados, Construcciones e Ingenier1a (in liquidation), Edificaciones en Madrid y Provincias (in liquidation), Gestion Colectiva, Gestion Iberica de Inversiones, Grucycsa, Inmobiliaria Sanboal, Intra Corporacion Financiera, Inversora S.A. and IEG, Mina Publica de Aguas de Tarrasa, Mobiliaria Continental de Inversiones, Obras y Servicios Publicos, Pesiver Corporacion Alimentaria, Pesquerias Espanolas del Bacalao, Promociones y Conciertos Inmobiliarios, Rentcapital, Sedatex, Sociedad Anonima Aurrera (in liquidation), Tipel and United Dutch Espana.
